question.text: When supporting investor fund due diligence and regulatory disclosures, a Cat III AIF distributor should:

answer.text: Compile additional information/documents for investor DD and, for regulatory disclosures, document the disclosure and obtain authorisation as applicable

explanation.text: The Logic: For investor fund due diligence, the distributor compiles or procures additional information/documents and assists related documentation. For regulatory disclosures, authorised disclosures are documented and required information is provided to SEBI inspectors. The Trap: Refusing disclosure, sharing only favourable information, or ignoring regulatory requests breaks both the investor-DD support role and the regulatory-disclosure obligation. Note: Keep investor DD requests and regulatory disclosure requests on separate tracks — gather/share documents for the former, document and authorise for the latter.
